A.explanation: Wave X at $5.2 \times 10^{-7} \text{ m}$ is far too short for radio waves, and wave Y at $9.4 \text{ GHz}$ is far too low in frequency for ultraviolet.

B.explanation: $5.2 \times 10^{-7} \text{ m}$ is longer than typical ultraviolet wavelengths, and $9.4 \text{ GHz}$ corresponds to a wavelength of centimetres, not to visible light.

C.explanation: $5.2 \times 10^{-7} \text{ m} = 520 \text{ nm}$ lies in the visible range, and $9.4 \text{ GHz}$ gives $\lambda \approx 3.2 \text{ cm}$, which lies in the microwave range.

D.explanation: Wave X is too short in wavelength for microwaves, and wave Y at centimetre wavelength is shorter than the principal radio-wave region.

hints: Notice the different givens: X is given as a wavelength of $5.2 \times 10^{-7} \text{ m}$, while Y is given as a frequency of $9.4 \text{ GHz} = 9.4 \times 10^9 \text{ Hz}$.
Recall the order of the spectrum and typical scales: visible light is about $400-700 \text{ nm}$, and all vacuum waves satisfy $c = f\lambda$ with $c = 3.0 \times 10^8 \text{ m s}^{-1}$.
Convert X to nanometres and calculate $\lambda = c/f$ for Y, then compare $520 \text{ nm}$ and a few-centimetre wavelength with the visible, microwave and radio bands.
walkthrough: Recall the principal order from short to long wavelength: gamma, X-ray, ultraviolet, visible, infrared, microwave, radio. Visible is roughly $4.0 \times 10^{-7} \text{ m}$ to $7.0 \times 10^{-7} \text{ m}$.
Check wave X directly: $\lambda_X = 5.2 \times 10^{-7} \text{ m} = 520 \times 10^{-9} \text{ m} = 520 \text{ nm}$. This falls inside the $400-700 \text{ nm}$ visible band.
Check wave Y using $c = f\lambda$ in a vacuum with $c = 3.0 \times 10^8 \text{ m s}^{-1}$ and $f_Y = 9.4 \text{ GHz} = 9.4 \times 10^9 \text{ Hz}$.

Rearrange to $\lambda_Y = c/f_Y = (3.0 \times 10^8)/(9.4 \times 10^9) \approx 3.2 \times 10^{-2} \text{ m} = 3.2 \text{ cm}$. A wavelength of millimetres to tens of centimetres is characteristic of microwaves, with much longer wavelengths belonging to radio waves.
So X is visible and Y is microwave. This is option C.
